inputs.text: [excited] It was about 6 feet long — as long as a motorcycle! Standing up, it was about 6 feet tall — [amazed] as tall as a front door! And it weighed 150 kilos — [proud] as heavy as a donkey!
[curious] As tall as a door, but a bird?
[confident] A bird on two very long legs, yes. [playful] Built for running, not for flying.
